name: Reply to Email
description: Reply to an email in Microsoft Outlook. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/message-reply)

configurable_props.name: messageId
configurable_props.label: Message ID
configurable_props.description: The identifier of the message to reply to

configurable_props.name: comment
configurable_props.label: Content
